rationale: S-0012-03 proposes integrating tuning_curve_loss into the t0008 Poleg-Polsky DSGC reproduction (deposited model) to score the ported ModelDB 189347 curve. The deposited-DSGC line was retired in brainstorm 9. The tuning_curve_loss is integrated into the from-scratch lineage instead via the metrics.json RMSE entries that t0052/t0053/t0054/t0057 each report against the t0004 target. Rejecting as the deposited integration target is no longer relevant and the loss function is in active use elsewhere.
